purpose: Owner rulings for the two governance shape inventories. A row records a judgement, not a budget: no count in this file is a threshold, and adding a row is never a way to raise an allowance. An unruled finding fails the gate so the judgement cannot be skipped; a ruled finding passes because an owner has answered for it.

verdicts.remove: Authority-free; delete it and let callers take the real owners.
verdicts.retain: Owns a real invariant or binding requirement stated in the reason.
verdicts.retain-prior: Already ruled by a named earlier plan; carried forward unchanged.
verdicts.repair: Confirmed defect owned by the named plan; not yet implemented.

aggregates.reason: One nullable `const AssetSystem*`. The nullable-registry fallback it documents is a parameter default, not an invariant, so the operations take the pointer directly.
The wrapper carries only `const ReflectionPassInputs&`, and its sole consumer immediately forwards `inputs.pass`; CA3 deletes it and takes the pass input directly.
The wrapper carries only `const ReplayRenderFrameView&`; CA3 passes the replay frame view directly.
The result carries only one borrowed solver sample pointer and enforces no result invariant; CA3 returns the pointer directly.
Single-member authored-setup context; the setup operation takes its one owner directly.
Single-member generated-setup context; the setup operation takes its one owner directly.
One `SceneController&` member, passed by value into CreateSceneFromUI. Strictly longer than taking SceneController& and shortens nothing.
The wrapper carries only `const ShadowPassInputs&`, and its sole consumer immediately forwards `inputs.pass`; CA3 deletes it and takes the pass input directly.
One `SceneWorld&` member. Identical in shape to PhysicsSleepPolicyUICommandContext; the two differ only by name and comment. Apply operations take SceneWorld& directly.

extraction_scars.reason: `IndexFunctionT& indexFn = fn;` binds a forwarding reference to an lvalue reference so the chunk lambda can capture it by reference. Deleting the alias changes capture semantics; this is a required binding, not a preserved pre-extraction spelling.
